body: Everyone deserves to experience a ye concert in person at least once in their life 🥹🐐 Ye’s 2026 world tour has officially become one of the biggest runs of his career, reportedly drawing over 1 MILLION fans across stadiums worldwide 🌎🐐 The run includes 118,000 fans in Istanbul, 150,000+ across two nights in Tampa, 140,000+ across two nights at SoFi Stadium, 83,000+ in Mexico City and another 65,000+ in New Orleans. source_caption_text:
Everyone deserves to experience a ye concert in person at least once in their life 🥹🐐

Ye’s 2026 world tour has officially become one of the biggest runs of his career, reportedly drawing over 1 MILLION fans across stadiums worldwide 🌎🐐

The run includes 118,000 fans in Istanbul, 150,000+ across two nights in Tampa, 140,000+ across two nights at SoFi Stadium, 83,000+ in Mexico City and another 65,000+ in New Orleans. Now, Ye is bringing it home with back-to-back nights at Chicago’s Soldier Field—and the tour still isn’t finished 🤯

Ye continues to prove that his catalog and live-show demand are truly generational.
